title: Associated and weakly associated points agree locally Noetherianly
statement: Let X be a locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth] and let O_X be its structure sheaf [def-pc-scheme]. The associated points of O_X are exactly its weakly associated points: Ass(O_X) = WeakAss(O_X). Here a point x is associated when the maximal ideal m_x of its local ring O_{X,x} is the annihilator of some element of O_{X,x}, and weakly associated when m_x is weakly associated to that local ring, meaning it is minimal among the prime ideals containing the annihilator of some element.

proof.text: For every point x of a locally Noetherian scheme, the maximal ideal of O_{X,x} is finitely generated by [lem-sc-locnoeth-stalk-maxideal-fg].

source.place: Tag 05AR, final sentence of Lemma 31.5.8 (locally Noetherian case)

proof.text: Apply the first assertion of Tag 05AR, recorded as [lem-sc-ass-weakass-fg-stalk], to the quasi-coherent structure sheaf F = O_X (whose stalk at x is O_{X,x}, so its associated and weakly associated points are those defined in the statement) at each point x, with the finite generation of m_x from step 1. It gives x ∈ Ass(O_X) if and only if x ∈ WeakAss(O_X), hence the two sets are equal.
